name: 02 - US VIRAL | Reel Factory

nodes.name: Get Recent Posts
nodes.notes: Posts of the last 48h + every READY post (daily cap, READY buffer, creator cooldown, no repeats).

nodes.name: Get Eligible
nodes.notes: ELIGIBLE candidates from Discovery. 0 rows = nothing to do, the run stops here.

nodes.name: Pick Candidate
nodes.notes: Daily cap, READY buffer, creator cooldown, best trend_score. 0 items = nothing to do.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'transcribe', params: { source_url: $json.candidate.url, language: 'en' }, ref: $json.post_key }) }}

nodes.name: Submit Transcribe
nodes.notes: Async job on the media worker: download audio + whisper word timestamps. Fails here = nothing locked.

nodes.name: Lock Candidate
nodes.notes: PROCESSING = owned by the Factory, Discovery stops touching it.

nodes.name: Create Post
nodes.notes: One row per Reel: viral_posts tracks it until published.

nodes.name: Transcribe Status
nodes.notes: done -> save, failed -> mark FAILED, queued/running -> wait again (bounded by the 300s execution timeout).

nodes.name: Release Candidate
nodes.notes: FAILED: not owned by Discovery, never picked again.

nodes.name: Build LLM Request
nodes.notes: The ONE model call per Reel: clip facts + timestamped transcript -> strict JSON schema.

nodes.name: Parse Script
nodes.notes: Validate model output: clamp segment, clean text and hashtags, build final caption + credit.

nodes.name: Mark Skipped
nodes.notes: SKIPPED = model judged the clip unusable; FAILED = API/JSON error.

nodes.name: Claude Script
nodes.notes: Claude Messages API, structured JSON output (output_config.format). Model/effort from viral_config.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'render', ref: $('Pick Candidate').first().json.post_key, params: { clip: { url: $('Pick Candidate').first().json.candidate.url, start: $('Parse Script').first().json.segment_start, end: $('Parse Script').first().json.segment_end }, intro: $('Parse Script').first().json.voice ? { text: $('Parse Script').first().json.intro_script, voice: $('Init Factory').first().json.config.tts_voice, speed: $('Init Factory').first().json.config.tts_speed, engine: 'kokoro' } : undefined, hook: $('Parse Script').first().json.text_style === 'hook' ? $('Parse Script').first().json.hook : '', top_text: $('Parse Script').first().json.text_style === 'meme' ? $('Parse Script').first().json.meme_caption : '', hook_seconds: 2.5, emphasis_at: $('Parse Script').first().json.emphasis_at, credit: $('Parse Script').first().json.credit, watermark: $('Init Factory').first().json.config.ig_handle, captions: $('Get Source').first().json.has_burned_captions === true ? 'intro_only' : (($('Init Factory').first().json.config.factory_full_captions_sources.includes($('Pick Candidate').first().json.candidate.source_key) || !$('Parse Script').first().json.voice) ? true : 'intro_only') } }) }}

nodes.name: Submit Render
nodes.notes: Clip-mode render: segment + Kokoro intro voice + captions + hook + credit (+ watermark).

nodes.name: Render Status
nodes.notes: done -> READY, failed -> FAILED, queued/running -> wait again.

nodes.name: Save Reel
nodes.notes: READY = video on the worker, waiting for the Publisher.

nodes.name: Time Left?
nodes.notes: n8n Cloud stops runs at 5 min: stop polling at ~4 min, the post stays RENDERING and is collected next hour.

nodes.name: Get Pending Renders
nodes.notes: Posts whose render outlived a previous run. 0 rows = branch stops.

nodes.name: Render Outcome
nodes.notes: running = left as it is (checked again next run).

nodes.name: Get Source
nodes.notes: Streamer settings (has_burned_captions). Always outputs one item, even for sources not in the table.

description: US VIRAL Reel Factory: picks the best ELIGIBLE candidate (caps, cooldown), then transcribe, 1 LLM call, render on the media worker.

nodeGroups.name: Setup
nodeGroups.description: Read viral_config and build the Factory settings

nodeGroups.name: Pick
nodeGroups.description: Caps + cooldown, then the best ELIGIBLE candidate (or stop)

nodeGroups.name: Start Job
nodeGroups.description: Ask the worker for a transcript, lock the candidate, create the viral_posts row

nodeGroups.name: Poll Transcribe
nodeGroups.description: Every 15s ask the worker if the transcript is ready

nodeGroups.name: Transcribe Failed
nodeGroups.description: Post FAILED + candidate FAILED (never picked again)

nodeGroups.name: Skipped
nodeGroups.description: Clip unusable or LLM error: post SKIPPED/FAILED, candidate REJECTED/FAILED

nodeGroups.name: Script
nodeGroups.description: Save transcript, then the ONE Claude call per Reel (JSON), validated before use

nodeGroups.name: Start Render
nodeGroups.description: Streamer settings, then send segment + intro + hook + credit to the worker, mark the post RENDERING

nodeGroups.name: Poll Render
nodeGroups.description: Every 20s ask the worker if the Reel is rendered

nodeGroups.name: Reel Ready
nodeGroups.description: Post READY with video_url/cover_url, candidate READY

nodeGroups.name: Render Failed
nodeGroups.description: Post FAILED with the worker error, candidate FAILED

nodeGroups.name: Collect Renders
nodeGroups.description: Renders that outlived a previous run: check the worker, READY / FAILED / still running
